# Krogh & Decker, LLP

> > Sacramento business and employment law firm specializing in construction law, PAGA litigation, corporate compliance, and commercial disputes throughout California.

Krogh & Decker, LLP is a Sacramento-based law firm providing legal services across business formation, employment law, construction disputes, mechanics liens, and regulatory compliance. The firm's attorneys, including Shawn Krogh, Trevor White, and Christopher Perez-Pruitt, handle matters involving the Private Attorneys General Act (PAGA), Corporate Transparency Act (CTA), and California-specific employment and construction regulations.

## Key Topics

- California employment law
- Construction law and mechanics liens
- PAGA (Private Attorneys General Act)
- Business litigation and commercial disputes
- Corporate Transparency Act (CTA) compliance
- Sacramento business law
- Workplace compliance and regulations
- UCC filings and payment disputes
- Corporate veil piercing and asset protection
- ADA compliance requirements
- Workers' compensation laws
- Business formation and due diligence
- Partition actions and property disputes
- California contractor licensing
- Background checks and hiring practices
